table.name: customers
table.purpose: Customer master table for a fuel-card / loyalty program (likely a Czech fuel retailer, given CZK currency and gasstations/products/transactions tables). One row per customer, referenced by transactions and a year-month aggregation table.

Currency.name: Currency
Currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the customer's billing currency. CZK (Czech koruna) dominates (~94%), EUR (~6%).

CustomerID.name: CustomerID
CustomerID.description: Primary key; unique numeric customer identifier. Referenced by transactions_1k.CustomerID and yearmonth.CustomerID.

Segment.name: Segment
Segment.description: Customer segment code. SME = small and medium enterprises (dominant), KAM = key account management (large accounts), LAM = local account management. Exact expansion of LAM/KAM is inferred from common sales-segmentation usage, not confirmed by the data.

table.name: gasstations
table.purpose: Reference/dimension table of gas stations (one row per station), identified by GasStationID, with attributes for chain membership, country, and market segment. Referenced by transactions_1k.

ChainID.name: ChainID
ChainID.description: Identifier of the retail chain/brand the gas station belongs to (233 distinct chains; e.g. 3, 2, 33 are the most common). No join to a chains table exists in this database, so the chain names are unknown.

Country.name: Country
Country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the station's location: CZE (Czech Republic, 4836 stations) or SVK (Slovakia, 880 stations).

GasStationID.name: GasStationID
GasStationID.description: Primary key: unique identifier of the gas station. Referenced by transactions_1k.GasStationID (many transactions per station).

Segment.name: Segment
Segment.description: Market/positioning segment of the station: one of 'Other', 'Premium', 'Noname', 'Value for money', 'Discount'.

table.name: products
table.purpose: Product/service catalog for a fuel-card system: each row is a billable product or service (fuels, shop goods, tolls, fees, card services) referenced by line items in the transactions table. Descriptions are in Czech, suggesting a Czech fuel-card issuer (e.g. EuroOil-style).

Description.name: product_description
Description.description: Human-readable name/description of the product or service in Czech (occasionally English/German), e.g. 'Katalyzátor' (catalyst), 'Potraviny' (food/groceries), 'Servisní poplatek' (service fee), 'AdBlue (jerrycan)', 'Toll access-Austria'. Not unique (529 distinct in 591 rows), so some products share descriptions.

ProductID.name: product_id
ProductID.description: Primary key of the products table; unique integer identifier for each product/service. Referenced by transactions_1k.ProductID (many transactions to one product).

table.name: transactions_1k
table.purpose: Fuel/petrol station purchase transactions (1,000-row sample, late Aug 2012): each row is one purchase of a product by a customer's loyalty/payment card at a specific gas station, recording the quantity (Amount), unit price (Price), date and time.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.description: Quantity purchased, in liters (fuel volumes; small values like 0-264 with median 19 fit liters of fuel).

CardID.name: CardID
CardID.description: Identifier of the card used for the transaction (loyalty or payment card); nearly unique per row, no join detected to another table.

CustomerID.name: CustomerID
CustomerID.description: Identifier of the purchasing customer; references customers.CustomerID (many-to-one).

Date.name: Date
Date.description: Date of the transaction (YYYY-MM-DD); sample covers 2012-08-23 to 2012-08-26.

GasStationID.name: GasStationID
GasStationID.description: Identifier of the gas station where the purchase occurred; references gasstations.GasStationID (many-to-one).

Price.name: Price
Price.description: Total price of the transaction (currency units, e.g. euros); consistent with Amount x unit price (e.g. 4 units -> 3.64).

ProductID.name: ProductID
ProductID.description: Identifier of the product purchased (fuel type or shop item); references products.ProductID (many-to-one).

Time.name: Time
Time.description: Time of day of the transaction, HH:MM:SS (24-hour).

TransactionID.name: TransactionID
TransactionID.description: Primary key; unique sequential identifier (1-1000) for each transaction row.

table.name: yearmonth
table.purpose: Monthly per-customer consumption summary: each row records a customer's total consumption (likely fuel volume or spending) for a given year-month (2011-2013). Aggregated from the transactions data by customer and month.

Consumption.name: Consumption
Consumption.description: Total consumption for the customer in that month. Units unclear: could be fuel volume (liters) or monetary amount; negative values suggest returns/corrections. Large values (up to ~2M) indicate aggregation over many transactions.

CustomerID.name: CustomerID
CustomerID.description: Identifier of the customer; references customers.CustomerID (many-to-one).

Date.name: YearMonth
Date.description: Year and month encoded as an integer string, e.g. 201205 = May 2012. Range 201112-201311 (Dec 2011 to Nov 2013).
